text: Yes, there was deforestation on this asset in 2023. The analysis detected a 4.5-hectare loss of tree cover, which meets the minimum event size threshold of 0.5 hectares. The area was confirmed as forest in 2020 by the JRC dataset, and the loss was observed in later years, including 2023. The affected area was primarily planted forest (4.3 hectares) with pine species (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), not native forest. Additionally, 1.3 hectares of smaller patches (under 0.5 hectares) were lost but not counted as part of the main event.
